newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises at fixing led by high caps.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises at fixing led by high caps.

text.p: Czech shares posted moderate gains at the price fixing on Friday led by most of the major issues.
Among the frontrunners was IPB Bank. The Finance Ministry on Thursday announced the sale of a 36 percent state-held stake in IPB to Japan's Nomura International plc for six billion crowns.
Nomura will raise the bank's basic capital by at least six billion crowns paving the way for Nomura to take a majority stake in IPB. IPB rose seven crowns to 250.
SPT Telecom rose six crowns to 3,641, Komercni Banka gained 32 crowns to 1,610 while Ceska Sporitelna was the only major issue not to rise. It was unchanged on 259.
